recommendation.rationale: Recommend scoped evaluation/adoption on the measured memory pull route only, not an automatic production model/index switch. Memory relevance improves over Harrier and downstream useful rates are mdenseon 0.935, Harrier 0.905, Gemma 0.936, with all 40 absent-answer queries rejected by every arm. Prose downstream useful-rate differences remain unresolved (Harrier minus mdenseon +0.003 [-0.014,+0.020], Gemma +0.014 [-0.003,+0.039]); however Gemma has a resolved lower unsupported-answer rate (-0.0089 [-0.0213,-0.0036]), so prose is not an unqualified adoption scope. Prose absent-answer rejection is mdenseon 0.965 versus Harrier 0.982 and Gemma 0.979. Exclude the production push route pending model-specific floor calibration: under shipped floors prose retrieval MRR is 0.095 below Gemma. Preserve the recorded CUDA mixed-length capacity incompatibility and the single fixed answerer/same-model judging limitations. A benchmark recommendation authorizes neither a model/index switch nor evicting GPU co-tenants.
scopes: Measured memory production-pull retrieval/answer-context route only; retain frozen top-k/context bounds and independently evaluate any production switch. Prose and production push routes are excluded from this adoption recommendation.

bars.finding: V21 blind independent labels (0 candidate-ranking exposure; memory 220 queries identical to V19; prose 1472/8460 queries accepted at judge agreement 0.547), paired source-target MRR deltas with 95% bootstrap CIs at the 0.03 margin. The D-008 stop rule is satisfied because the census is exhausted for both corpora (memory 312 and prose 1601 test sources, all eligible sources authored; 40 and 275 accepted test sources), not because every margin resolved. The residual uncertainty is therefore the final result. MEMORY vs harrier: ALL_ANSWERABLE +0.093 [0.046, 0.148] and lexical-gap +0.163 [0.072, 0.267] are improvements above the margin; exact-identifier and session-start-intent are unresolved. MEMORY vs gemma: ALL +0.030 [-0.012, 0.074], unresolved in every class. PROSE vs gemma: a small measured REGRESSION, reported and not tuned away: ALL -0.017 [-0.032, -0.002] and exact-identifier -0.015 [-0.030, -0.002] (both CIs exclude 0 but not the margin); lexical-gap and intent are unresolved. PROSE vs harrier: ALL +0.020 [0.003, 0.038] and lexical-gap +0.049 [0.011, 0.085], unresolved vs the margin; exact-identifier is inside the margin. Judge cost disclosed per D-008: 12,355 claude-sonnet-4-6 calls, $649.38, quadratic by design.

Three pinned incumbent recipes passed 16 controlled token/vector comparisons each and all eight query rankings agree with the independent Python ONNX/tokenizer/pooling reference; corrected isolated Gemma has zero observed token/vector/rank effect. A killed counterexample shows the CLI refuses a reference recipe identity collision. Production profiles unchanged.

Complete production hybrid retrieval (canonical/memory/lexical/hybrid/filter/entity/decay) ran in three model-owned benchmark schemas over one frozen snapshot: memory 160 q on the V19 gold (its memory census is proven identical to V21), prose 1140 q on the V21 gold. 27/27 pin, comparability and isolation assertions pass; leakedHits 0 and positive controls 5/5 per arm. PULL route: mdenseon vs gemma MRR d=+0.015 [-0.036,+0.064] memory and -0.020 [-0.039,+0.000] prose; vs harrier +0.033 [-0.012,+0.080] memory and +0.019 [-0.006,+0.044] prose. All four are unresolved against the 0.03 margin (no decision-relevant loss detected at this power, which is not equivalence), and hard-negative admission is identical (1.0) in every pull pair. PUSH route (the shipped push floors minScore 0.58 / minLexScore 0.4, cosine-gated, shared across arms and not recalibrated per model): vs gemma on prose, MRR d=-0.095 [-0.119,-0.073] is a LOSS beyond the margin; recall@10 d=-0.083 [-0.107,-0.061]; 20/855 positives come back empty (gemma 0); precision d=+0.075 [+0.057,+0.093] where both arms return results; hard-negative admission drops 1.0 to 0.965 (d=-0.035 [-0.060,-0.014]). On memory push vs gemma, MRR d=-0.017 is unresolved, recall@10 d=-0.058 [-0.100,-0.025], and admission drops 0.975 to 0.75. vs harrier push, MRR is unresolved on both corpora (memory +0.032, prose -0.011). Reading: no pull-route loss was detected against either incumbent; under the shipped push floors mdenseon loses prose push quality to gemma, so any push-route adoption needs those floors recalibrated for mdenseon and re-measured first.

Controlled five-fresh-process-block CPU performance over the local-http-client-worker route: 15 cells / 5 blocks, every reported latency distribution backed by its ordered raw request samples and exact route identity (verifyCompletedPerformanceRun, no inference).

CPU boundaries and corrected CUDA reproduce stored parity at the fixed vector gates; 9/10 CUDA cells pass including single 8192 and over-limit truncation to 8192 and a padded 5-input batch. Mixed-length [2,8192] is an explicit device-capacity allocation failure under production GPU co-tenancy (D-007), kept as an explicit device identity, not a model loss.

defects.rootCause: OPEN: under Compute Sanitizer, native Node teardown after a CUDA allocation failure aborts with a corrupted double-linked list; bounded native/instrumented CUDA ownership observations are complete but the historical heap cause is unresolved.
defects.guard: The [2,8192] cell is recorded as an explicit device-capacity allocation failure (D-007) rather than a parity result; the defect stays open and owned.

bars.finding: All three real-weight runs (mdenseon, gemma, harrier v3) passed every phase gate: crash/restart recovered with identity intact and no inline rescue, the old worker retired within the bound, bounded soak completed. Two defects found and fixed on the way (SIGABRT on in-flight terminate; inline main-thread rescue on teardown); every v3 run is post-fix.

defects.rootCause: Terminating the embed worker during in-flight ONNX inference raised Napi::Error and aborted the host (SIGABRT 134).
defects.guard: Fixed and done; sidecar-robustness crash phase gate (v3 runs post-fix).

defects.rootCause: Worker teardown rescued shutdown-rejected gemma/harrier requests by inline main-thread inference, blocking the sidecar event loop ~10s.
defects.guard: Fixed and done; robustness gate requires no inline rescue.

bars.finding: Memory: useful rates mdenseon/Harrier/Gemma 0.935/0.905/0.936, all 40 absent-answer queries rejected by all arms. Prose: 1140 queries (855 answerable, 285 absent-answer); useful 0.85175/0.84835/0.86523. Paired useful differences versus mdenseon: Harrier +0.00272 [-0.01361,+0.01996], Gemma +0.01377 [-0.00275,+0.03949], unresolved. Unsupported rates 0.02387/0.01940/0.01411; Gemma-minus-mdenseon -0.00888 [-0.02131,-0.00355] is a resolved loss for mdenseon. Absent-answer rejection 0.96491/0.98246/0.97895. Judge correctness/grounding kappa 0.885/0.781 over 3304 pairs; inconclusive judgments remain explicit. Exact-fingerprint receipt replay accounted separately from new calls; reported completed-receipt costs exclude failed-call billing.
